title: Medical exam for migrants and residence permits
also: medical exam for a work permit
what: A medical check for foreigners who are getting a work or residence permit. It checks for some infections and sometimes for drug use.
why: When applying for a work permit, a residence permit, a residence card or citizenship.
duration: usually 1 to 2 visits, results in a few days
tell_doctor: If you have had tuberculosis, hepatitis, HIV or other infections

prepare.title: What is included
prepare.text: Usually a blood test for HIV and syphilis, a chest X-ray and exams by doctors are needed. The list depends on the country and the document - ask the migration office or the clinic.

prepare.title: Clinic
prepare.text: The exam can only be done at clinics that are authorized for it. Find out the list in advance.

prepare.title: Translation
prepare.text: If you have documents in another language, a translation may be needed.

bring: Your passport and a translation of it, if needed
Your migration card or other papers
steps: You come to a clinic authorized to do the exam
You see the doctors on the list
feel: The blood test is a short needle prick
after: Keep the original of the certificate and a copy
Submit your papers on time - certificates are valid for a limited period
If something is found, you will be referred to a doctor

faq.q: Can I have the exam at any clinic?
faq.a: No, only at those that are authorized. Ask the migration office.

faq.q: What if a test is positive?
faq.a: You will be referred to a doctor. The clinic and the migration office will explain the next steps.

reminders.text: Medical exam tomorrow. Take your passport, translation and migration papers.
